query:
SELECT a.invite_quota,
                  coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN i.revoked OR i.expires_at <= now() THEN i.uses
                                    ELSE i.max_uses END), 0) AS "taken!"
           FROM accounts a
           LEFT JOIN invites i ON i.account_id = a.id AND NOT i.by_admin
           WHERE a.id = $1
           GROUP BY a.id
